item_name: Rothco Two Tone Specialist Carry All Shoulder Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco’s 2-Tone Specialist Carry All Shoulder Bag is the perfect blend of functionality and style. Constructed from durable heavyweight cotton canvas, this bag is designed for long-lasting performance while maintaining a classic look. The spacious main compartment includes an inside pouch for storing larger gear, while 2 front pockets and 3 snap-secured exterior pockets keep smaller tools and accessories organized. 2 additional open-top pockets on the back of the bag add even more storage versatility.
description: Rothco’s 2-Tone Specialist Carry All Shoulder Bag is the perfect blend of functionality and style. Constructed from durable heavyweight cotton canvas, this bag is designed for long-lasting performance while maintaining a classic look. The spacious main compartment includes an inside pouch for storing larger gear, while 2 front pockets and 3 snap-secured exterior pockets keep smaller tools and accessories organized. 2 additional open-top pockets on the back of the bag add even more storage versatility. Featuring an adjustable shoulder strap and sturdy top carry handles, this carry-all bag adapts to your needs, making it ideal for work, travel, or daily use. The 2-tone accent trim adds a touch of sophistication to its rugged design, ensuring it’s both practical and stylish. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
